definitions.content: A facility that is incorporated in a measuring instrument which enables significant faults to be detected and acted upon.

notes.content: "Acted upon" refers to any adequate response by the measuring instrument (luminous or acoustic signal, prevention of the measurement process, etc.).

definitions.content: Dispositif intégré à un instrument de mesure pour permettre de détecter et de mettre en évidence des défauts significatifs.
